question: DenseNet-style sequence tower as a single model, against the deployed per-residue MLP tower
protocol: five seeds, each at its own validation-selected threshold, de-leaked split; identical loss/hyper-parameters/data
verdict: not adopted: nominally worse than the MLP tower as a single model (n.s.), and a third member is not significant in the ensemble either; consistent with the earlier findings that explicit structure on top of the RiNALMo representation does not help (graph on RiNALMo, Mamba)
caveat: the DenseNet inherits the MLP tower hyper-parameters (lr 5e-4, dropout 0.1 in the dense layers, 120 epochs); no sweep was run for a convolutional tower
